How we work

Four principles, in plain language.

01

Senior or training to be

We hire people who can lead a project end-to-end. If you're not there yet, we'll tell you, and we'll mean it when we say we'd love to talk again in 18 months.

02

Writing is the job

Sharp design follows sharp writing. Every role here writes — briefs, post-mortems, proposals — and we evaluate it at every step.

03

No heroics

We staff projects so nobody works weekends. If a project starts to need heroics, we have failed at scoping, not at hiring.

04

Outcomes over hours

We track what shipped and what moved. We don't track when you logged on.
